links.outcome: Risk-prediction accuracy of LLM agent using evidence-based clinical tools versus commercial LLMs without them
links.effect: RiskAgent (8B) reached 76.33% accuracy on MedRisk, outperforming o1, o3-mini and GPT-4.5 and doubling GPT-4o's 38.39%.
links.quote: The results show that our RiskAgent, with 8 billion model parameters, achieves 76.33% accuracy, outperforming the most recent commercial LLMs, o1, o3-mini, and GPT-4.5, and doubling the 38.39% accuracy of GPT-4o.

unlisted_practices: Tool-augmented LLM agent that calls validated clinical risk calculators to reduce fine-tuning cost and hallucination

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks an autonomous AI agent (RiskAgent) using tool-use with clinical risk calculators on automated benchmark datasets.
